newsitem.title: USA: Sunquest licensed to use Multum product.
newsitem.headline: Sunquest licensed to use Multum product.

text.p: Sunquest Information Systems Inc said on Thursday it signed a license agreement with Multum Information Services Inc to use Multum's software components within Sunquest's Caregiver patient-information system.

Caregiver provides clinical data and channels patient information across a health-care system to caregivers. Multum's MediSource SDK software development kits expand Sunquest's clinical capabilities, the companies said.
Multum, based in Denver, is privately held.
